weight_note: Legacy relative weights kept for reference. Ranking metric Impact factor (sum) uses impact_factor (Clarivate JIF) instead.
impact_factor_note: Clarivate Journal Impact Factor, JCR 2026 release (2025 JIF, 17 Jun 2026). Compiled from public reprints of that JCR (not a live Web of Science export). Metric weighted_if = sum(impact_factor) per paper. jcr_quartile is the journal's best Clarivate JCR 2025 quartile across its Web of Science categories. abdc is the 2025 ABDC Journal Quality List rating (A*, A, B, C) when the journal is listed; omitted if not.
